answer: Plant decoys in the grading pool. Each epoch the seed mints forty answers that read well and fail: right length, all three words, a mechanism that contradicts itself two lines down. They sit among real work like copper coins in a silver tray. Attestors keep a score over two hundred votes; decoy accuracy under sixty percent zeroes the weight and forfeits the 150 POA bonded at join, and epoch-seeded decoys resist any blocklist. Real readers then cost forty cents a vote, sixteen thousand an epoch. A trellis is known by the vine that climbs it; a sparrow perching there proves nothing.
